skill.name: i18n-localization
skill.description: Review internationalization patterns, detect hardcoded text and missing locale keys, and improve formatting, fallback, pluralization, and RTL support.
skill.summary: Audit application localization and apply practical i18n patterns across supported frameworks.
skill.author: sickn33

Line 53 opens a fenced TSX example for Next.js localization. The backticks delimit documentation and are not evaluated.
Line 60 closes a Markdown code fence. It performs no command execution.
Line 64 opens a fenced Python gettext example. It is inert Markdown content, not a Ruby or shell execution operator.
Line 68 closes the Python example fence. No process or command is invoked.
Lines 74 through 86 show an illustrative locale directory tree inside a Markdown fence. They do not contain executable shell commands.
Line 86 closes the fenced locale directory example. It is Markdown formatting with no execution behavior.
Line 125 opens a fenced CSS example about logical properties and RTL layout. The fence is not an executable backtick expression.
Line 135 closes the CSS documentation fence. It does not invoke an external command.

content.value_statement: Hardcoded text and incomplete locale files create inconsistent multilingual experiences. This skill reviews localization structure, detects common gaps, and recommends practical i18n patterns.
actual_capabilities: Detects common hardcoded strings in React, Vue, and Python source files.
Finds JSON, PO, message, translation, locale, language, and i18n resource files.
Compares flattened JSON translation keys across multiple locale directories.
Reviews translation keys, namespaces, fallback behavior, pluralization, and locale-aware formatting.
Provides implementation examples for react-i18next, next-intl, Python gettext, and RTL CSS.
limitations: The checker scans at most 50 source files.
Regex detection can miss dynamic text or report non-user-facing strings.
Locale completeness comparison supports JSON files, not PO content.
The skill does not create professional translations or validate linguistic quality.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Web Application
use_cases.description: Review components, locale files, formatting, and RTL behavior before a multilingual release.

use_cases.title: Check Translation Coverage
use_cases.description: Compare locale key sets and identify missing or extra entries across supported languages.

use_cases.title: Establish i18n Standards
use_cases.description: Define translation namespaces, fallback rules, formatting patterns, and release checks for a product team.

prompt_templates.title: Find Hardcoded Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [project path] for hardcoded user-facing text and list each likely issue with its file and recommended translation key.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit of application source files

prompt_templates.title: Compare Locale Keys
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare locale files under [locale path], using [base locale] as the reference, and summarize missing or extra keys by language.

prompt_templates.title: Review Locale Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess pluralization, date and number formatting, fallback behavior, and RTL support for [framework] and [supported locales].

prompt_templates.title: Plan an i18n Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a phased migration for [application], covering key structure, framework integration, locale resources, automated checks, fallback policy, and RTL testing.

output_examples.input: Review the checkout interface for hardcoded text.
output: CheckoutPage.tsx contains three likely hardcoded labels.
Move each label into the checkout namespace.
Use stable keys for the title, submit action, and delivery message.

output_examples.input: Compare English, Turkish, and Arabic locale files.
output: Turkish is missing two authentication keys.
Arabic has one extra checkout key.
Review Arabic screens in RTL mode after aligning the key sets.

output_examples.input: Recommend safer date and number localization.
output_examples.output: Use locale-aware formatters for dates, currencies, and counts. Define fallback locales and test representative values for every supported region.

best_practices: Use stable translation keys grouped by feature namespace.
Apply locale-aware plural, date, number, and currency formatting.
Test fallback locales, long text, and RTL layouts before release.
anti_patterns: Do not concatenate translated fragments into complete sentences.
Do not assume every language uses the same text length or direction.
Do not treat automated key checks as linguistic quality review.

faq.question: Which frameworks does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It includes patterns for React, Next.js, Vue, Python gettext, and generic locale file structures.

faq.question: Can it find hardcoded strings automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. The included checker uses regular expressions for common React, Vue, and Python patterns.

faq.question: Does it compare translation completeness?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares flattened keys across JSON locale files grouped by language directory.

faq.question: Does it translate content?
faq.answer: No. It supports localization structure and review, but professional translators should verify language quality.

faq.question: Can it validate RTL layouts?
faq.answer: It recommends logical CSS properties and RTL checks, but visual validation still requires application testing.

faq.question: Will the checker modify project files?
faq.answer: No. The included script reads matching files and prints findings without writing changes.
